column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3: Departure for the Papal Office
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: This is the $$アンゲルス教団$$'s $$総本山$$—the $$教皇庁$$!?
The truth of this $$世界$$ is here!
Those bastards $$ユダ$$ and $$バアル$$ have gotta be up ahead too!!
Yes! We absolutely have to meet $$ケルビム$$ and find out the truth!!
You chase $$ルカ$$—no, that $$リリス$$!!
There's a good chance the $$ご主人様$$ you're seeking is where she's headed!
And if things go our way... that woman may take us straight to the $$教皇$$!!
I'll come with you too!!
I want to repay my $$ご主人様$$'s kindness, even a little!
Please take me too... I might only be able to help by picking up money, but...
$$ご主人様$$!!
Please, let my strength be of use to you now!
$$ご主人様$$!! Let me come with you too!
Please... let me join you on your journey too!!
Even this old fool... must have something left he can do for the $$世界$$!!
Somehow... I smell money in this!
$$ご主人様$$, take me with you toooo!
Hey, hey—it's okay if I come along, right...?
It is my duty... to be of service to you...
Me? I'm coming along whether you like it or not!!
Please let me come too...
I'm sorry, $$レブロブス$$...
Hey, $$ご主人様$$—please! I can come too, right...?
Now is the time... let me repay the kindness you showed me!!
I... merely follow the $$古の盟約$$...
All right, then!!
Hurry. I'm worried about what they're doing!
